subject: Non-invasive durable evidence to existing-session business loop
inside: Desktop task-scoped EvidenceDocument JSON persistence and validation
Live assistant response projection into capability follow-ups
Answer citation navigation, canvas reveal and widget focus

outside.contract: The existing session controller owns model routing, credentials, tool policy, streaming, cancellation and persisted turns; the capability supplies display and bounded submit text only.
Future authorized adapters upsert provenance-bearing artifacts into the same task EvidenceDocument contract; unavailable credentials never produce fabricated live data.
